text: Day thirty-one. You open the drawer. Same phone. Same lock screen. Hundreds of notifications. And for the first time in years... you don't rush to check them. Your hand goes to your pocket. And this time... it waits. So tell me honestly. Could you last thirty days? Or even three? Next time: what if you saved one hundred rupees every day for twenty years? (beat) But that story... is for the next What If.
